name: Jan Novak
bio:
Jan Novak's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but in the stands. As a child, the roar of the engines during the Brno Grand Prix ignited a passion that shaped his career. After earning a degree in Human Resources, he sought to combine his professional skills with his love for racing.

He started in a smaller rally team, quickly proving his ability to navigate the complex world of motorsport personnel. Jan is known for his pragmatic approach to HR, focusing on building strong, cohesive teams that deliver results. His experience has taught him that success in motorsport hinges on more than just talent; it requires meticulous planning, clear communication, and a deep understanding of each individual's needs and aspirations.

His commitment to ethical practices and fostering a positive work environment distinguishes him from many in this field. He believes in empowering employees and creating a culture of continuous improvement, making him a valuable asset to any racing organization.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Jan is of average height, with a focused gaze and a serious demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations.
Has a collection of miniature racing helmets on his desk.
Insists on starting every team meeting with a brief motivational quote.
